ownership.quote: Falcon, a former Navy Seal trainee and Facebook AI Research intern, started developing PyTorch Lightning while an undergraduate student at Columbia... Their venture, Lightning AI, takes the open source framework and layers enterprise-focused services and tools on top.

stage.quote: With the new $50 million investment, which comes from Cisco Investments, J.P. Morgan, Nvidia, and K5 Global, Lightning AI's total war chest stands at $103 million.
stage.note: TechCrunch never labels the Nov 2024 $50M round's letter. Priced-round history found: seed (undisclosed, ~2019, Index Ventures participated) -> Series A $18.6M (2020, led by Index Ventures) -> Series B $40M (2022, led by Coatue) -> this $50M round (2024, Cisco Investments/J.P. Morgan/Nvidia/K5 Global). Assuming standard lettering this would be Series C; not confirmed as such in press.

total_funding_usd.basis: Company-stated total per TechCrunch, quoting CEO/company figures directly (not an aggregator estimate).
total_funding_usd.quote: Lightning AI's total war chest stands at $103 million.

last_round.quote: the company recently raised $50 million in a funding round... which comes from Cisco Investments, J.P. Morgan, Nvidia, and K5 Global.

note: Lightning AI is the commercial entity behind the open-source PyTorch Lightning framework, founded by William Falcon (with Luis Capelo); originally launched as Grid.ai in 2020, rebranded to Lightning AI in June 2022 alongside its Series B. As of Nov 2024, described as New York-based with ~50 employees and 230,000+ developers / 3,200+ organizations on the platform; no acquisition, shutdown, or layoffs reported.
